mentl/f38986b:
A default is not a call-site convenience. SYNTAX desugars it once at the
declaration into a callee-scoped fill evaluated in the callee's parameter
scope, so the default's row is the callee's row — and a caller under
`with !E` meets it although the call site names neither the parameter nor
the effect.

Measured in all three shapes before either fixture was written: a direct
effectful default refuses with `!E + Any vs E`, a closure default that is
called refuses, and a closure default never called accepts. That is the
latent-versus-performed split the field, list, tuple, variant, state and
partial carriers already pin, at the carrier none of them reached.

The pair is its own RED evidence, which is the only honest form available
for pinning behaviour that is already correct: add `b()` to the sound
fixture and it becomes the leak, which rejects; remove it and the leak
becomes the sound twin, which accepts.

Worth a crucible because the wheel writes no default-valued parameter at
all — 0 across 29 src modules against 2079 fn declarations by the same
engine, so the zero is a verdict, not an empty read. Fixpoint, census,
micros and march are structurally silent here, which is §11 tripwire 3.

That grep is a confession, so it is named: Hβ.query.default-param-census,
the census shape that would let the medium answer "does the wheel
exercise this surface" the next time the selector owes an oracle-blind
probe.

Crown 48 -> 50, both legs green. Tests only; boot unchanged.

mentl/f320f97:
An authored 'pos: ValidOffset' bound the raw syntactic TName onto the
param handle; the env's TAlias(name, TRefined(base, pred)) — the edge
the type declaration drew — was never read. Downstream the compare
dispatch (emit_one_compare_helper, keying on fold_strip) saw a bare
nominal and minted $compare_nValidOffset, the SUM compare: scalar below
heap_base (4096), tag-compare of DEREFERENCED OPERANDS above it. In m3,
lex_from's 'pos >= n' ran through that fold, so the moment an input
exceeded 4096 bytes the compare read mem[pos]/mem[n] as variant tags,
returned 0, and the lexer took the EOF branch: every m3 compile saw at
most the first 4096 bytes. The wheel lost its own tail — lib/ never
registered (the six E_MissingVariable in m4.err: print_string,
make_list, list_extend_to, list_set, str_concat_all, slice are all lib
fns), reachability collapsed 2560→2129, and m4 emitted 6KB of
scaffolding. Surfaced by 8042ea2: before the seed registered refinement
aliases, the annotation was an inert free var and every compare floored
scalar — the binding made the snapshot visible.

Three cuts, one home each:
- pre_register_stmt gains RefineStmt/AliasStmt arms: aliases are pure
  env writes, so they register order-free (types.mn sorts after
  lexer.mn in the wheel; the main walk previously registered them after
  every src/ annotation had already converted).
- The main walk's RefineStmt arm keeps only the predicate's Verify
  obligation; AliasStmt dissolves to the pre-pass home.
- quantify_ctor_ty's uppercase-nullary leaf resolves the name through
  env_lookup: a Forall(_, TAlias(..)) entry binds as the live alias
  (transparent to unify, stripped by fold_strip/repr_of to the base
  scalar); nominal records / ADTs / undeclared names stay TName.

mentl/f391785:
The compiler now evaluates constant expressions at compile time:
  (1 + 2) * 3  →  emits LoadInt 9 (one instruction, not five)
  100 - 50 + 25  →  LoadInt 75
  -(42)  →  LoadInt -42

Recursive tree-walking evaluator: try_eval_const handles nested
BinOp/UnaryOp trees, Int/Float arithmetic, comparisons, string
concat, boolean negation. The compiler KNOWS these expressions
are pure — C can't do this without __attribute__((const)).

This is Phase 1 of the performance push: more knowledge = more
optimization. The compiler is smarter, not lower-level.
